g.text: Serving plane (hot path reads memory only)
Analytics spine (READ-SIDE - never feeds the bid path)
Feedback loops (the only analytics → serving paths)
Delta lake (10-15s micro-batches, no daily ETL)
1 · MEMBERSHIPS - profile-builder (hourly chain) recomputes segments over the lake → PG → Redis ≤30s later. A behavioural rule reaches live auctions within one preload cycle.
2 · MONEY - billing engine computes committed spend from ingested events → NATS spend snapshot → DSP overwrites its Redis pacing counters to billed reality.
3 · WARM-STARTS (boot) - adserver bandit seeds from historical CTR; exchange SmartRouter from dsp_calls. Then live signals take over.
4 · IDENTITY - identity-consumer streams graph edges → PG → DSP in-memory snapshot; profile-builder pre-expands memberships across clusters so loop 1 covers every device of a person.
campaigns · placements · creatives · deals · publishers · secrets
